# Dossier

> Shows a Workspace member what the Brain knows about one thing: its facts with their sources, its documents, and what is connected to it by kind, as counts and lists; opens one of its documents the way a search hit opens.

| Kind | code |
| Owner | `ROLE-ENGINE-OWNER` |
| Status | planned |
| Level | 2 |
| Parent | `L1-WORKSPACE` |

## Purpose

### Responsible for

| Id | Aliases | Statement | Code |
|---|---|---|---|
| `L2-PLATFORM-DOSSIER/R-1` | `L2-PLATFORM-BRAIN-VIEWS/R-2` | The dossier (PMVP-30a): one thing's name and kind, its facts - each with the document its source passage is in, or the mark «ohne Beleg» - and its documents, read as the person signed in, behind the switch brain_views.enabled; and opening one of those documents, checked with the Core per click, the way a search hit opens. | `KnovasPlatform/components/docbridge_integration/src/brain_views/dossier.py`; `KnovasPlatform/components/docbridge_integration/src/web_interface/dossier_routes.py`; `KnovasPlatform/components/docbridge_integration/src/web_interface/templates/dossier.html` |
| `L2-PLATFORM-DOSSIER/R-2` | `L2-PLATFORM-BRAIN-VIEWS/R-3` | The dossier's related things by kind (PMVP-30b): one tab per kind with its count, in the plural from one table, and behind it the list of that kind (each row a link to that thing's dossier, with its relation), sorted, filtered and paged at 50; the documents as the same kind of list. Read as the person, per thing: one neighbours read and one round of kind reads. | `KnovasPlatform/components/docbridge_integration/src/brain_views/related.py`; `KnovasPlatform/components/docbridge_integration/src/brain_views/plurals.json`; `KnovasPlatform/components/docbridge_integration/src/web_interface/dossier_routes.py`; `KnovasPlatform/components/docbridge_integration/src/web_interface/templates/dossier.html` |
| `L2-PLATFORM-DOSSIER/R-3` |  | The card «Läuft gerade» on the dossier's Überblick (PMVP-32a): the step a thing is in, from the neighbours the dossier already read (an in_state edge to a neighbour of kind ProcessStep), named without its process's prefix, opening the thing's process line. | `KnovasPlatform/components/docbridge_integration/src/brain_views/related.py`; `KnovasPlatform/components/docbridge_integration/src/web_interface/dossier_routes.py`; `KnovasPlatform/components/docbridge_integration/src/web_interface/templates/dossier.html` |

### Not responsible for

- The Brain views' blueprint, its switch and its gate, the 25-node limit and the stylesheet (L2-PLATFORM-BRAIN-VIEWS); the routes here are attached to that blueprint behind its gate.
- The process line a thing's card «Läuft gerade» opens (L2-PLATFORM-PROCESS-LINE).
- The links from names in search results and answers to the dossier; the search page (the web app) and the assistant draw them (PMVP-33).
- Who may read a node, a fact or a document: the Core decides, and answers 404 for what the person may not see (graph_api.py, document_readable). Serving a document's file: the web app's file routes and their gate (app.py, document_grants.py); the dossier hands them the one document a person clicks, after the Core's check, through the web app's grant, as the search page does with its rows.
- How a document opens: the search's own enrichment and settings (app.py: \_enhance_listing_rows, pdf_inline_in_browser, \_download_open_enabled) and the file routes; the dossier picks among them in the order a search hit does. What an experiment document is: the Experimente module's split (experiments/search.py), which the dossier calls.

### Terms

- dossier (the page for one thing - what the Brain knows about it)
- ohne Beleg (the mark of a fact that has no source passage the person can open from the dossier)

- How a fact's value is written as text, and the order of the facts.
- The mark-up and the class names of the dossier; the page is built from the shared page parts.
- The plural of a kind's name: one table, brain_views/plurals.json, read by brain_views/related.py (the legal pack's kinds, the pilot's kinds, the reference screens' words); the Brain has no plural.

## To review

| At | Why |
|---|---|
| `/owner` | Proposed owner, as for every card in this repository; one role per component is confirmed by a person (Software Map K4). |
| `/status` | Live or planned is not read from the code: the dossier (PMVP-30a) is built on the Platform MVP's branch, behind a switch that is off by default, and not on main yet. |
| `/source_paths` | Split from L2-PLATFORM-BRAIN-VIEWS by PMVP-32a (context budget: together the card was 17,839 tokens before the process line); every moved line keeps its old id as its first alias. The dossier's routes moved from brain_views_routes.py into dossier_routes.py without a change of behaviour; they hang on the Brain views' blueprint and its gate. |
| `/operations` | The dossier's two routes and the function that attaches them; the call has no line, as the console's attach functions have none (its one caller is the Brain views' factory). |
| `/uses` | Declared, as the code reader does not follow the client's methods to the routes they call. /secured/document_readable is on no operation of EXT-BRAIN-API yet (FU-15). Used from the web app as well, which has no card: the file routes (document_external_open, preview_document, download_document), the grant (\_grant_for_current_user), the search's enrichment of a row (\_enhance_listing_rows) and its open settings (pdf_inline_in_browser, \_download_open_enabled), and the Experimente module's split (experiments_search.split). |
| `L2-PLATFORM-DOSSIER/*/P-1` | Does not hold yet, so it has no evidence: a fact's source is the Core's provenance_pointer (the document), provenance_chunk_id (the passage) and provenance_status, and no per-thing route returns a passage's text or its page. What holds is http.GET.dossier.\_node_id/P-4: a fact without a mark opens its source document. Follow-up FU-38; the Core request CR-2 (docs/platform-mvp/core-requests.md, one chunk read by its id) would close it. A fact whose document the Core did not list among the node's documents for this person is marked «ohne Beleg» even when it has a passage: the Core shows a fact when any one of its evidence chunks is readable (graph_access.visible_fact_ids), so its provenance document is not known to be readable. |
| `L2-PLATFORM-DOSSIER/http.GET.dossier._node_id/P-5` | Until the Core's CR-R1 the counts and lists are what the Core hands the caller: under «Aus» (every tenant today) every person sees every related thing; B-07 (facts and counts follow the person's rights) is a 12 January row. The lists sort and filter on the Platform over what was read (decision D4 of PMVP-30b): the Core has no paged neighbours read, so a hub with thousands of neighbours is read whole on each page view; accepted for the MVP. The Core's neighbours read applies no limit of its own at depth 1. |
